admission.justification: A future worklist/UI change must not turn advisory directory context into changed item identities, fabricated reach or new gate obligations; doing so would invalidate stored judgments for display-only reasons.

applicability: Mechanical route-chain enrichment of converted-leaf touched, stale and unexplained worklist items from the already parsed candidate memory.
conditions: Route-chain lookup uses candidate families and the leaf-chain selector over the same parsed side, reporting family IDs, titles and routes under a mechanical label.
Enrichment preserves the existing item envelope and identity and adds context only; the assembly applies it to the selected item kinds.
exclusions: Context is not a semantic reachability computation, a new worklist item, a satisfaction judgment or publication authority.
No second store or blanket claim that every family in a directory is reached.
statement: Route-chain facts on touched, stale and unexplained items provide mechanical candidate-family context without changing item identity or raising items.
